nugetCli.code:
dotnet nuget add source {{SITE_URL}}/nuget/index.json --name liquid-glass
dotnet add package {{NUGET_ID}} --version {{VERSION}}

pluginShell.code:
claude plugin marketplace add rookasrudzianskas/liquid-glass-mac-windows-ios-android
claude plugin install liquid-glass@liquid-glass-engineering

skillsManual.code:
curl -LO {{SITE_URL}}/downloads/liquid-glass-skills.zip
unzip liquid-glass-skills.zip -d ~/.claude/skills    # Claude Code
unzip liquid-glass-skills.zip -d ~/.agents/skills    # Codex and other Agent Skills tools

verify.code:
curl -LO {{SITE_URL}}/downloads/SHA256SUMS   # into the folder with your downloads
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing    # macOS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing        # Linux
Get-FileHash .\LiquidGlassStudio-win-x64.zip     # Windows PowerShell (SHA-256 by default)
